Know the parts.
Connect by pin name.

Reference hardware: ESP32-DevKitC V4 with ESP32-WROOM-32E, KY-015 / DHT11, and KY-018 / LDR.

Fit R3: your DHT11 module has no built-in DATA pull-up. Drivers are implemented; physical sensor acceptance is still pending. R3 is 10k between DATA/GPIO27 and 3V3. The light-filter capacitor C1 is optional and may be omitted; keep both divider resistors.
KY-015

DHT11 timed digital interface • DATA → GPIO27 • supply 3.3 V

Connection schedule

SenderDestination
3V3Both modules + / VCC
GNDBoth modules − / GND; divider and capacitor ground
GPIO27KY-015 S / DATA; required external R3 10k pull-up to 3V3
GPIO34 / ADC1_CH6KY-018 S through R1/R2 divider; optional C1 to GND

Check the actual module markings

These manufacturer drawings identify the reference modules. Header orientation and board revisions vary. S / + / − labels are authoritative, not the apparent left-to-right order of the overview.

KY-015 manufacturer pinout

KY-018 manufacturer pinout

Power the sender by USB. Use its 3V3 output for both modules; keep signal pull-ups at 3.3 V. GPIO27 is digital DHT data; GPIO34 is an ADC1 input. SmartDisplay communicates over Wi-Fi and has its own power supply.
